headline: Congress directed the awarding of a congressional gold medal to golfer Jack Nicklaus to honor his service to the nation.
what_it_does: The law asks the Speaker of the House and the President Pro Tempore of the Senate to arrange a presentation of a congressional gold medal to Jack Nicklaus. It directs the Treasury Secretary to strike the gold medal and also to strike and sell bronze duplicates, priced to cover the cost of both medals.
when_it_takes_effect: Enacted on December 16, 2014, the date it became law.
